Illintsi Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Vinnytska oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. This is the older of Illintsi's two Jewish cemeteries. The town's Jewish community suffered six separate pogroms between 1917 and 1920 alone, and more than 40 houses were looted; 2,489 Jews were killed during the German occupation of 1941–1944. As recently as November 15, 2019, the largest synagogue in the Vinnytsia region — located in Illintsi — burned down, a significant loss for the region's Jewish heritage even in the present day. Only five gravestone fragments survive at this abandoned cemetery.
